limits: Complete cached camera loops are independent of transport; new camera poses require the GPU connection.
During preparation frames preview at generation speed; normal-speed looping starts once the complete loop is available.
Adaptive preview uses single temporal sample during interaction and may reduce width to 640px; stationary preload uses selected resolution, JPEG quality and temporal sampling.
No unconditional FPS guarantee for device overload, background tabs, unavailable GPU or network when changing views.
